summary: Bound Liepin search and detail tab ownership inside the supervised sidecar.
rationale: The Source Port sidecar is the only production browser-effect owner for Liepin cards and details. This change reuses one search tab and one detail tab across candidates and sidecar generations, makes direct readiness reuse the same extension-owned search surface without becoming a cards or details effect owner, and keeps poisoned or missing tabs fail closed until the extension proves the owned session is empty.

deletion_targets: Per-candidate Liepin detail tab allocation in the supervised sidecar
Main-process cards and details browser observation after Source Port dispatch
Synchronous sidecar tab close during poisoned or missing tab retirement
Per-query random direct-verify tab sessions and their separate control fence lane
Unbounded or blocking sidecar stderr capture
risks: A retiring tab must block replacement while the extension still reports any live, ambiguous, invalid, or unknown owned-session state.
A sidecar restart must recover only one unambiguous live extension-owned tab and must not trust stale Python memory.
The bounded replacement budget must not become durable candidate truth or a second browser lifecycle control plane.
The user host tab and host window must never be navigated, automated, closed, activated, or replaced.
Direct readiness may observe or create the shared search surface but must never execute cards or details browser effects.
Sidecar failure diagnostics must remain privacy-safe, non-blocking, capped, and independent of Source Port reconciliation.
line_count_rationale: The pre-existing oversized adapter remains the provider semantic boundary. This slice changes only its existing search/detail broker call sites; the reusable ownership and retiring state live in the focused generic browser automation module.
